claims.text: Sagimun’s approximate summary describes Gowa trade restrictions, fort transfer and coerced indemnity. The local account’s renewed fighting distinguishes formal terms from continued compliance. De Clercq’s translated Ternate account instead describes a Company fief and payments to office groups after revolt and capture. The Dutch East India Company’s two recorded relationships are not identical obligations, original signed instruments or evidence of universal consent and uninterrupted rule.
